title: Market regime time series + transition calendar. 6 regimes: accumulation, markup
description: Market regime time series + transition calendar. 6 regimes: accumulation, markup, distribution, markdown, high_volatility, crisis. Snapshot every 15min via ML regime detector. Use ?transitions_only=true for compact change-event feed, ?days=1..90 for window. Returns distribution_pct across regimes, current_regime, series. AI agent API for regime-aware strategy switching, macro-regime backtesting, and market-structure monitoring.
